name: Győrság (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and yellow in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Győrság (a blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a plough and a bough on a green base) above a yellow scroll inscribed GYŐRSÁG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
